visual.general_description: Two columns of six line plots each, comparing thrombin-stimulated platelet CD62 (column A) and CD63 (column B) exposure of patients P1, P2.1, P2.2, P2.3, P5 and P6 with a day control.
visual.detailed_description: Column (A) shows six small line charts with y axis "log anti CD62-FITC" (0 to 400) and column (B) six with "log anti CD63-FITC", all with x axis "Thrombin (U/mL)" from 0 to 1. In every chart a blue line with triangles is labeled "day control" and a magenta line with squares is labeled with the patient (rows, top to bottom: P1, P2.1, P2.2, P2.3, P5, P6); a dotted grey line with light grey lines above and below shows a healthy control pool. In (A) the magenta curves lie below the blue curve in P1, P2.1, P2.2 and P2.3, with smaller gaps in P5 and P6. In (B) the magenta curve is clearly below the blue one for P1, P2.1 and P2.2, closer for P2.3 and P5, and nearly overlapping for P6.

panels.detailed_description: Six stacked line plots with y axis "log anti CD62-FITC" 0 to 400 and x axis "Thrombin (U/mL)" 0 to 1. Blue triangles joined by a blue line are labeled "day control" at the right of each plot and magenta squares are labeled with P1, P2.1, P2.2, P2.3, P5 or P6; dotted grey and light grey lines mark the control pool. Patient curves for P1, P2.1, P2.2 and P2.3 plateau below the day control (P2.3 ends at about 220 versus about 305), and P5 and P6 lie closer to the control.
